service: Virtual Assessment - live video call in the Mold Busters Virtual Inspection app

people.who: Staff C (admin support) / Staff D (admin support)
Automated SMS + emails (Close CRM, 'Bruce' virtual support)

client_concern: From the online booking form: black and white mold inside the washing machine, around the washer and dryer, inside ventilation ducts and around the oven. A strong smell in the apartment that does not go away even after deep cleaning. Client said they are a tenant.

timeline.system: Booking page -> Google Calendar 'MB - Virtual Inspections'
timeline.what: Client books a VA slot and fills a short form (address, owner/tenant, concerns). The calendar event is created automatically with the form answers, an admin link to the video platform, and an automatic AI 'financial analysis' of the area.
Booking email with app links (Android/iOS) - client joins with their phone number. SMS reminder with a pre-inspection survey (Google Form).
Lead created automatically (via API) from the VA calendar.

Inspector talks with the client (about 19 min). From 4:12 to 7:08 the client walks the camera through the laundry (washer drum, dryer vent), ceiling and wall vents and the oven. Inspector captures 3 snapshots for the report.
Admin writes the Virtual Assessment Report, second admin reviews. Asana card created, tagged PAID, notes 'report SENT, estimate SENT'. Card closed in 12 minutes.
Client gets the report link (inspector in CC). About 1.5 hours after the call started.
Status moves 'Survey Request' -> 'Review Request'. SMS asks the client to rate the VA app in the app stores.
6 automated 'MB Marketplace' emails, every 3 days (referrals to plumbers, electricians, handymen).
IAQ estimate viewed, not accepted. No further booking found.

findings: Client reported health issues while living in the unit.
On the video call the client showed visible discoloration (dryer vent hose, ceiling vent, wall vent grille). It may be fungal, but it cannot be confirmed without sampling.
recommendations: See a doctor about the health issues
Book a professional Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) test for mold
Limit time and traffic in the affected areas until then

scope: Indoor Air Quality assessment on site
75 L air samples sent to an accredited third-party lab
Visual check during sampling (thermal camera, moisture, temperature/humidity/dew point as needed)
Written summary once lab results arrive; full payment needed before results are released

files.what: De-identified reference report; compare against inputs rather than treating every statement as verified ground truth.
Structured case and timeline for building/testing.
2m56s client-camera walkthrough, audio and metadata removed. Full identifiable call is excluded.
